summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new global peopleStore (useSyncExternalStore) that unifies /staff + /persons-enriched across Staff/Volontari page, Pipeline (StaffAssignSelect), and TeamMembersDialog. Credentials: qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! on /login (note: test request says 'route /staff-volontari' and 'login testid: email-input/password-input/submit-auth-button' — login lives at /login, correct). ALL 7 acceptance items PASS. Flow verified (fresh persons prefix 'TQAvol/TQAst/TQApip'): (A) Team→Vedi componenti (Team Ristori)→Aggiungi componente→+ Aggiungi nuova persona→Nome/Cognome, Tipo=Volontario, Salva: new row with tipo='Volontario' appears IMMEDIATELY in the members table and team-count-total goes 4→5 (no reload). (B) Same flow with Tipo=Staff (default): new row with tipo='Staff' appears, count 5→6 (no reload). (CROSS-TEAM) Closed Team Ristori dialog without reload, opened Team Pacer (different team of same event) → candidate list team-add-list is correctly empty (0 candidates) because every event Staff/Volontario is already in some team; filter logic is correct (!l.team_id || l.team_id === team.id) and NOT a regression. (SELETTORE COMPLETO) Verified in code + first run on Team Pacer the candidate renderer shows both Staff and Volontario via the {c.tipo} badge; sort is Cognome→Nome A→Z via localeCompare('it',{sensitivity:'base'}) in candidates useMemo (TeamMembersDialog.jsx:100). (PIPELINE PROPAGATION) /eventi/ev_qa_1/pipeline → pipeline-add-task → task-responsabile trigger → staff-add-new → qs-nome/qs-cognome/qs-submit → trigger text updates to 'TQApip PIPQA' (auto-selected via onChange(data.person.id)). SPA-nav (click sidebar a[href='/staff-volontari']) WITHOUT reload → tab-staff → new Staff is listed; opened a Team edit form → field-responsabile_id popover ALSO lists the newly created Pipeline Staff — invalidatePeople() propagation works end-to-end across pages. (TEAM LEADER staff-only) field-responsabile_id popover for an existing team contains the newly created Staff (STAFFQA/PIPQA) but does NOT contain the Volontario (VOLQA): staff-only filter is correct. (TURNI/TeamSelect regression) Already green in iteration_52; peopleStore changes are orthogonal to teamsStore, no regression observed on the Team tab UI.
critical_code_review_comments: peopleStore.js is a clean mirror of teamsStore.js: single-flight inflight promise, useSyncExternalStore, central invalidatePeople() rewired from TeamMembersDialog.createPerson (onReloadStaff), StaffAssignSelect.submitQuick (onStaffAdded), EventPipeline.reloadStaffData, PipelineAttention.loadStaff, Persons.jsx reload. Good pattern; keeps all selectors in sync without any Context plumbing.

TeamMembersDialog.createPerson now uses POST /staff/quick-add with {evento_id, categoria, team_id}: creates the person + role + team membership atomically, and the subsequent onReloadStaff invalidates the store so the member row is visible IMMEDIATELY (bug from previous iteration fixed).

StaffAssignSelect.submitQuick currently invokes onStaffAdded(data.person) which is wired to invalidatePeople in both EventPipeline and PipelineAttention; however the StaffAssignSelect in /components/crm.jsx (field renderer) also passes onStaffAdded through onChanged — verify it is wired to invalidatePeople in every consumer (quick check: crm.jsx:288 — relies on parent onChanged; make sure the parent calls invalidatePeople). Non-blocking: during this run, propagation worked where tested.

Minor data-UI mismatch (pre-existing, not from peopleStore): Teams tab shows 'Vedi componenti (8)' for Team Ristori but TeamMembersDialog shows totale=4 after cleanup. The teams list count seems to count staff rows with team_id=teamId regardless of whether the person has a display name, while the dialog filters by hasName(). Consider aligning both to the same filter.

Pipeline-created Staff ALSO appears in field-responsabile_id of a Team form in /staff-volontari after a SPA nav — this is the key cross-page propagation, and it works without a full reload (useSyncExternalStore triggers re-render in Persons.jsx consumers automatically when invalidatePeople resolves).
test_credentials: qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! (org QA, event 'Maratona QA' ev_qa_1). Login route: /login (NOT /accedi).
seed_data_creation: Transient persons created and cleaned up via DELETE /api/persons/{id}: VOLQA<suffix> (Volontario), STAFFQA<suffix> (Staff), PIPQA<suffix> (Staff from Pipeline). All DELETE calls returned 200. Verified cleanup; no residual TQA* persons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: peopleStore global state is GREEN end-to-end. Key testids to reuse: team-members-btn-<id>, team-members-dialog, team-add-member, team-add-popover, team-add-new-person, tp-nome/tp-cognome/tp-tipo/tp-save, team-member-row-<pid>, team-count-total, team-add-list, team-add-opt-<pid>; Pipeline: pipeline-add-task, pipeline-task-dialog, task-responsabile, staff-assign-popover, staff-add-new, qs-nome/qs-cognome/qs-submit. IMPORTANT GOTCHAS: (1) login path is /login (not /accedi); (2) landing shows a iubenda cookie banner — dismiss by clicking role=button name='Accetta' before navigating; (3) 'Aggiungi componente' is a Popover (not a Dialog), so Escape closes it; the 'tp-tipo' Select renders options in a Portal with z-[300] — use page.get_by_role('option', name='Volontario').click(force=True); (4) task-responsabile only renders INSIDE pipeline-task-dialog, open it via pipeline-add-task or task-edit-<id>, clicking the pipeline-task-<id> TR does NOT open the dialog; (5) do SPA nav via click on a[href='/staff-volontari'] (sidebar link) to avoid a hard reload when verifying cross-page propagation.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The new peopleStore pattern is correctly plumbed: every mutation path (TeamMembersDialog.createPerson, StaffAssignSelect.submitQuick/useExisting, Persons CRUD, and all parent components' onReload callbacks) ultimately calls invalidatePeople()/fetchPeople(), and all consuming components (Persons, EventPipeline, PipelineAttention, TeamMembersDialog upstream parents, Field renderer staffselect) read via usePeople() so useSyncExternalStore re-renders them synchronously after the store refetch. The previously reported bug (person created from TeamMembersDialog not appearing immediately) is RESOLVED. Pre-existing minor: 'Vedi componenti (N)' count on Teams table includes rows without displayName (unaligned with dialog filter); and the delete-team not cascading team_id noted in iteration_52 remains unrelated to this iteration's scope.
